extracted.name: Authentic Cincinnati Chili
extracted.description: Cincinnati chili is Ohio-style comfort food! This recipe will feed a crowd; serve over hot spaghetti or have it 4-Way with onions and Cheddar cheese.
ingredient_lines: 1 quart water, or amount to cover
instruction_lines: Place ground beef in a large pan, cover with cold water, and bring to a boil, stirring and breaking up beef with a fork to a fine texture. Slowly boil until meat is thoroughly cooked, about 30 minutes.

Add onions, tomato sauce, vinegar, garlic, Worcestershire sauce, and chocolate. Stir in chili powder, salt, cumin, cinnamon, and cayenne pepper until well mixed. Add cloves, allspice berries, and bay leaf.
Bring to a boil, reduce heat to a simmer, and cook, stirring occasionally, for 3 hours. Add water if necessary to prevent chili from burning.
